item.title: Major General Rezaei stresses Iran’s determination to strengthen strategic cooperation with Russia
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council, Major General Mohsen Rezaei, in a meeting with Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov in Tehran, has emphasized the Islamic Republic of Iran’s determination to strengthen strategic cooperation between Tehran and Moscow.

item.title: Iranian and Brazilian FMs call for continued diplomatic efforts to reduce regional tensions

item.title: Iranian Foreign Ministry issues warning to Iranians regarding travel to France, Belgium, and Italy
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – In light of intensifying unrest and disruptions to public order in France, Belgium, and Italy, the Public Relations Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic of Iran advises Iranian citizens to refrain from making non-essential trips to these countries or being present in areas affected by the unrest.

item.title: Iran summons German ambassador over baseless allegations
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – The German ambassador to Tehran was summoned to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs due to the repeated, baseless accusations made by German officials; during the meeting, the Islamic Republic of Iran’s strong protest regarding the contemptible approach taken by certain German officials toward Iran was conveyed to him.

item.title: Iran summons rotating president of European Union
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – In response to the inclusion of baseless allegations against Iran in the statement issued at the European Union summit, Aidan Cronin, the Ambassador of Ireland—which currently holds the rotating presidency of the EU—was summoned to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs by Alireza Yousefi, Assistant to the Foreign Minister and Director-General for Western Europe.

item.title: Armed Forces chief calls for review of defense preparedness in wake of recent wars
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Chief of Staff of Iran's Armed Forces Major General Ali Abdollahi has called for a review of defense preparedness in light of recent wars, urging the Armed Forces to enhance its defense capabilities based on lessons learned and in line with the hybrid, technological, and intelligence-driven nature of future wars.

item.title: China condemns US-Israeli attacks on Iran, opposes unilateral sanctions
